in_marathi.name: Trijal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victorious in Three Battles
in_marathi.long_meaning: Trijal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Trijal is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a masculine name. It is a compound name made up of the prefix tri, meaning three, and the suffix jal, meaning battle or victory. In Hindu mythology, Trijal is believed to be a warrior name, symbolizing the strength and courage of a victor in three battles.
